articles.title: Game 149: Royals at Red Sox lineups and notes
articles.description: Ranger Suarez gets the ball for the Red Sox, who take on Randy Dobnak and the Royals.

articles.title: Plenty of stories to be told of Joe Morgan, who lived a baseball life to the fullest right to the end
articles.description: Tales about Morgan, signed by the Boston Braves in 1952 and in the game until 1991 when his Sox managerial run ended, will be aplenty at his wake in Walpole Thursday.

articles.title: Junior Caminero’s walk-off home run helps Rays become first team to clinch playoff berth this season
articles.description: Caminero's 417-foot shot to left-center off Bryan Abreu was his 40th of the season and sparked a joyous celebration at the plate.

articles.title: Sonny Gray battles, but gets battered by sub-.500 Royals as Red Sox drop a third straight to a laggard
articles.description: The Red Sox lost their third straight game as the Royals put nine balls in play against the starter at 100 m.p.h. or harder.

articles.title: Garrett Crochet throws off the Fenway mound for the first time since May
articles.description: While being cautious, the lefthander is eager to get to a point where he can contribute to the Red Sox this season.

articles.title: Red Sox excited about the intangibles as much as the talent of draft picks Jake Schaffner and Owen Hull
articles.description: The pair of University of North Carolina products have high-motor work ethics that suggest a willingness to embrace the hard parts of the game in order to get better.

articles.title: Game 148: Royals at Red Sox lineups and notes
articles.description: The Royals are 3-7 in their last 10 games. Sonny Gray will be on the mound for Boston.

articles.title: Red Sox’ plan is not to have Mickey Gasper catch that much, but it could happen again
articles.description: Gasper gives the Red Sox an extra option behind the plate as Adley Rutschman deals with pain in his right elbow.

articles.title: At 36 and in his 14th season, Sonny Gray is having one of the best years of his career. How is he doing it?
articles.description: A meticulous practice routine as well as creativity and vision on the mound are among the factors that have led to success for the Red Sox righthander.

articles.title: Angels rough up Jake Bennett and hand Red Sox their second loss in a row
articles.description: Bennett allowed five runs in a span of eight pitches in the third inning.

articles.title: Chance at playoffs led Isiah Kiner-Falefa to sign with Sox, and it looks like his vision will come true
articles.description: The veteran utility player's versatility should help the Red Sox in the postseason.

articles.title: Adley Rutschman gets cortisone shot, sits out again amid continued right elbow issue
articles.description: Mickey Gasper started at catcher in Rutschman's place, Gasper's first appearance at catcher in a major League game since June 22.

articles.title: Game 147: Angels at Red Sox lineups and notes
articles.description: Jake Bennett will be on the mound when the Red Sox close out their series with the Angels Wednesday night.

articles.title: Projecting the Red Sox playoff roster: Tough calls must be made to reach 26 players
articles.description: With the end of the regular season 19 days away, the Red Sox have been working behind the scenes to consider the makeup of their playoff roster.

articles.title: What turned New Hampshire’s Mickey Gasper into a Red Sox hero? His ‘delusional’ determination.
articles.description: Gasper’s recent 16-game run at the plate have few precedents in Sox history, and stands as a testament to his extraordinary level of perseverance.

articles.title: Red Sox shut down by Reid Detmers, Angels to end five-game win streak
articles.description: Detmers allowed one hit in six innings with nine strikeouts, lowering his ERA to 3.32.
